tags.throws: Will throw an error if `defaultValue` is an invalid boolean value.

parameters.name: defaultValue
parameters.description: - The initial value for the boolean state (default is `false`).

returnType.name: UseBooleanReturn
returnType.description: An object containing the boolean state value and utility functions to manipulate the state.

properties.name: setValue
properties.description: Function to set the boolean state directly.

properties.name: setTrue
properties.description: Function to set the boolean state to `true`.

properties.name: setFalse
properties.description: Function to set the boolean state to `false`.

properties.name: toggle
properties.description: Function to toggle the boolean state.
